model_family: Gaussian factor copula with normal log10-leptin and arithmetic-moment-parameterized lognormal positive endpoints

evidence_use.operator: arithmetic means and sample SDs on complete endpoint pairs
evidence_use.population: 44 completers aged 7-14 with simple obesity; before/after 3-month home diet/exercise program with professional follow-up; no randomized parallel arm; 43 glucose and triglyceride pairs.
evidence_use.measurement: units specified per endpoint; pediatric leptin already log10(pg/mL)
evidence_use.reason: Use the supplied rounded means and sample SDs as plug-in population moments in a same-population A0 reconstruction. Convert arithmetic moments analytically to lognormal parameters for the three positive endpoints; leptin remains on its supplied log10 scale. Finite samples fluctuate rather than having moments forced exactly. These target-derived inputs supply no independent validation or information about joint dependence.

evidence_use.population: 44 completers aged 7-14 with simple obesity; before/after 3-month home diet/exercise program with professional follow-up; no randomized parallel arm; 43 glucose and triglyceride pairs.
evidence_use.reason: Generate one paired record per synthetic completer and no parallel control arm. At n=44 retain 44 leptin/body-mass pairs and 43 glucose/triglyceride pairs, with both unavailable pairs on the final synthetic record as required by the schema. For other n, round endpoint n times requested n divided by 44. Both-null fields encode an unavailable analysis pair, not native cell-level missingness; synthetic row order has no clinical meaning.

components.name: marginal_measurements
components.source_to_target_assumptions: Rounded source means and SDs approximate population moments for independent synthetic persons. Leptin is Gaussian on log10(pg/mL). Body mass, glucose and triglycerides follow lognormal marginals on their declared measurement scales. No extra log10 transformation is applied to leptin.
components.implementation: For a positive marginal, log-variance=log(1+(sd/mean)^2) and log-mean=log(mean)-log-variance/2. Realized means and SDs remain stochastic.

components.name: unidentified_joint_dependence
components.source_to_target_assumptions: Each latent measurement combines independent standard normal factors with variance shares 0.15 stable common-person, 0.50 stable endpoint-person, 0.10 common visit-person, and 0.25 endpoint-visit residual. This yields latent within-endpoint pre/post correlation 0.65, cross-endpoint same-visit correlation 0.25 and cross-endpoint cross-visit correlation 0.15. The shared visit factor imposes positively associated latent changes. All shares and signs are construction assumptions, not estimates or conclusions from the evidence.
unresolved_dependencies: Actual pre/post covariance for every endpoint
Actual cross-endpoint covariance at and across visits
Whether a common visit factor exists or has mixed endpoint signs

components.name: pair_availability_and_identity
components.source_to_target_assumptions: New synthetic IDs and exchangeable persons; fixed trailing complete-pair gaps imposed by the schema. No age, sex, adherence, intervention-effect heterogeneity, dropout mechanism or causal control group is inferred. Shared final-row gaps do not establish common native missingness.

scenarios.assumption: One fixed positive-persistence Gaussian factor copula with the explicit 0.15/0.50/0.10/0.25 variance shares, normal log10-leptin and lognormal positive endpoints. Dependence uncertainty is not resolved or exhaustively represented by this single model.
scenarios.inclusion_rationale: A parsimonious paired repeated-measurement construction with stable participant variation and modest shared visit variation is a plausible rehearsal model. The factor construction is positive semidefinite without estimating unsupported covariance. It was selected before numerical diagnostics; no reserved outcome, coefficient, direction, p value or interval was consulted. Twenty cohorts are resource allocation, not a posterior scenario probability.
unresolved_dependencies: Paired covariance and change SD for each endpoint
Sampling uncertainty in the rounded source marginals
affected_analysis_classes: Four paired endpoint change means and paired t intervals
